paper_title: A Glacier Ice Thickness Estimation Method Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 156 states that SwissALTI3D DEM data can be accessed at the exact Stage-1 URL and explicitly uses the SwissALTI3D 2019 DEM for Swiss glacier slope/topography inputs. Current official swisstopo documentation independently verifies swissALTI3D as the relevant high-precision elevation model. Existing Stage-1 relationship PRL000035 is therefore verified.
evidence_location: paper Study Area and Data/Data Availability Statement; official product and 2019 release documentation

paper_title: Physics-Informed Graph Neural Networks for Collaborative Dynamic Reconfiguration and Voltage Regulation in Unbalanced Distribution Systems
evidence_summary: Atlas paper 196 states in its numerical-study setup that it adopts one year of time-series load and solar-PV data created by NREL as dataset reference [38], allocating 300 days to training, 30 to validation, and 30 to testing. Reference [38] is Sample IEEE123 Bus system for OEDI SI at the exact Stage-1 URL https://data.openei.org/submissions/5773. OEDI and federal catalog metadata independently verify the dataset title, DOI 10.25984/2228282, public access, and content. Existing Stage-1 relationship PRL000039 is verified.
evidence_location: paper Numerical Study Setup and reference [38]; OEDI and federal dataset metadata
